items.item_text: Strategic Leadership and Resource Planning
Serve as a principal advisor to the Dean on financial, operational, and infrastructure strategy.
Lead development and execution of short- and long-term strategic plans related to resource management and organizational effectiveness.
Establish performance metrics and operational goals aligned with School priorities.
Identify and mitigate risks to organizational resources (financial, human, and physical)
Financial Management and Budget Oversight
Provide overall leadership for the School’s financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting.
Oversee allocation and management of funds across academic programs, research support, and operations.
Ensure compliance with UC policies and external funding requirements.
Direct financial strategy to support growth in enrollment, research, and program development.
Organizational and Staff Leadership
Provide direct supervision and leadership for:
Director of Academic Operation Services
Director of Research Facilities and Space Planning
Instructional Lab Manager
Director of Academic Personnel and HR
Director of Graduate Programs
Director of Undergraduate Student Affairs
Establish organizational structure and optimize staffing to meet School needs.
Foster a collaborative, high-performing administrative environment and ensure accountability.
Academic and Administrative Operations
Oversee operational support for:
Academic personnel processes (AP reviews, recruitments, merits, promotions)
Graduate and undergraduate program administration
Student advising services
Ensure coordination across units to support efficient curriculum delivery and student services.
Implement operational improvements to enhance service quality and efficiency.
Facilities, Space, and Infrastructure Management
Direct planning and management of research and instructional space, facilities, and infrastructure.
Oversee lab planning, renovations, and space allocation in coordination with campus units.
Ensure facilities meet teaching, research, safety, and compliance requirements.
Develop strategies for growth, optimization, and utilization of space resources.
Campus and External Engagement
Represent the School of Engineering on campus-wide committees related to space, infrastructure, finance, and operations.
Collaborate with central units including Finance, HR, Facilities, and IT.
Engage with external stakeholders as needed in support of School initiatives.
Policy, Compliance, and Risk Management
Develop and enforce policies and procedures governing administrative operations.
Ensure compliance with UC policies, regulatory requirements, and audit standards.
Oversee risk management strategies related to personnel, financial, and facilities operations.
